svg.title: Role Battle Day 05 versioned role schema mind map
svg.desc: Detailed manually authored mind map of versioned role data, aggregate validation, atomic publication, connection-scoped role requests, UI compatibility, and verification.
svg.text: Day 05 - make role data safe before it owns runtime identity
2026-08-13 | versioned input - aggregate validation - atomic registry - connection-scoped request - verified handoff
VERSION 2 ROLE REGISTRY
Only a complete candidate becomes authoritative server state.
Clients submit one stable ID; Day 06 applies it to actors.
DAY 05 COMPLETE
BEFORE: PERMISSIVE FLAT JSON
Unsafe getters could fail or publish fragments
No explicit schema version or full role identity
Duplicate role IDs silently overwrote map entries
Bad reload could replace a valid registry with null
Login ownership still depended on process-global save state.
Civilian had no validated presentation or capability contract.
AUTHORED V2 DATA
Three explicit definitions, one stable format
Aura: Player / Magic / Combatant
BungeeMan: Player / Gun / FireGun LMB
Civilian: AmbientNPC / CivilianAI / no offense
Full tags, flags, attributes, grant arrays, unlockables,
nested equipment, real mesh, and compatible AnimBP.
SAFE AGGREGATE VALIDATOR
Every safe error joins one diagnostic report
TryGet type checks and finite numeric checks
Duplicate IDs, full tag categories, profile compatibility
Assets, mesh/Anim skeleton, body and weapon sockets
Ability path, tag, input, category, offense, projectile
Version 1 receives fixed Aura/BungeeMan migration only.
Warnings may publish; any error rejects the whole candidate.
ATOMIC PUBLICATION
InitGame establishes truth before PreLogin
Parse into a transient candidate
Publish only when bCanPublish is true
Bad reload retains exact last-good object
No first good config: role service unavailable.
Existing actors are never hot-swapped by reload.
PER-CONNECTION ROLE REQUEST
Travel carries only Role=<StableRoleId>
PreLogin rejects missing, unknown, ambient, nonselectable
InitNewPlayer re-parses and revalidates the option
Each PlayerState stores its PendingAcceptedRoleId
HandleStartingNewPlayer and RestartPlayer stop if missing.
No global GameInstance slot authorizes server ownership.
UI AND VERIFICATION
Compatibility stays strict and observable
Saved Aura and BungeeMan IDs remain valid
Civilian/unknown saved IDs are rejected with status
13/13 Day 05 automation tests passed
Day 05 Listen + Dedicated smokes passed
Day 04 Listen + Dedicated regressions passed
Smoke restores source config and reload sentinel in finally.
BOUNDARY FOR DAY 06
Day 05 decides which role definition and connection request are trustworthy. It deliberately does not apply a role to an actor.
Day 06 consumes PendingAcceptedRoleId once, checks actor-shell compatibility, and applies validated identity and loadout deterministically.
NON-PARTIAL GUARANTEE
All roles publish together or not at all
Authored JSON - normalized candidate - aggregate validation - atomic registry - stable connection option - pending server role - Day 06 handoff
